title: Stone Assimilator
keywords: Collects health or hunger from mature Calculator-tree leaves into a matching module

blocks.text: Collects health or hunger from mature Calculator-tree leaves into a matching module.

rows: Place beside a three-block trunk, facing away from it.
Provide at least the required nearby leaf count.
Insert a module with matching nutrient capacity and allow leaf maturity.

blocks.text: Wrong trunk orientation, insufficient mature leaves, a full module or denied world actions can stop collection.
